verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail ships built-in AI features: instant AI summaries, automatic labels and AI categorization of scanned mail. These do some work on the user's behalf, but they are passive automations, not an assistant the user can hand tasks to. Missing for 10: an interactive or conversational AI assistant, the ability to delegate arbitrary tasks (e.g. forwarding, shredding or depositing via instruction), agentic multi-step actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
